title: Dropping a file onto a photo field uploads it, and a stray drop on the event form no longer opens the file and loses the form

source.ref: Toni House of Fates QA audit 2026-11-16 (project thread), item 7

detail:
EVIDENCE: components/ui/image-upload.tsx had no drag or drop handler, and app/(main)/events/new/event-form.tsx none either. Dropping a PNG or PDF onto the Cover image on the manual event form made Safari open the file in the tab, and everything typed into the form was gone.

CLOSED 2026-11-16: ImageUpload now has a drop zone around its control (one fix for every form that uses it). It lights up while a file is dragged over it, cancels the browser's default, and sends a dropped image through the same pick() gate as the file input (type, size, HEIC conversion, upload). A dropped PDF gets 'That is a PDF. Cover images need to be a photo (JPG or PNG).' and any other non-image a matching plain line (lib/library/upload-kinds.ts droppedFileProblem, unit-tested). The event form cancels dragover and drop on the form itself, so a drop that misses the photo field does nothing instead of navigating away.

verify.note: Fails on main: ImageUpload has no drop zone, no PDF message exists and the event form does not cancel a stray drop. Passes once all three are in source.
